name: CASE-26: Red Team C2 Lab -- Sliver Adversary Emulation
description: MITRE ATT&CK techniques executed in the CASE-26 Sliver C2 adversary emulation lab against a Windows 11 Enterprise victim. Attacker: REMnux (192.168.93.137). Victim: Windows 11 Enterprise eval. C2: Sliver v1.7.7 HTTPS beacon.

techniques.comment: Victim executed CASE26-beacon.exe transferred from REMnux via HTTP/SMB. Sliver beacon compiled for windows/amd64 with symbol obfuscation enabled (4m11s build time).
Sliver beacon established HTTPS C2 channel to REMnux listener on port 443 (192.168.93.137:443). Beacon interval 1m0s with jitter. Traffic encrypted with mTLS over HTTPS.
Beacon payload added to HKCU\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run to maintain persistence across reboots. No elevated privileges required for HKCU key.

metadata.name: ATT&CK
metadata.value: T1547.001 Boot or Logon Autostart Execution: Registry Run Keys

techniques.comment: Token impersonation used to escalate from standard user to SYSTEM context. Sliver getsystem command used for token theft via named pipe impersonation.
Mimikatz sekurlsa::logonpasswords executed against lsass.exe from SYSTEM context to dump plaintext credentials and NTLM hashes from memory.
NTLM hash from Mimikatz dump used in pass-the-hash attack to authenticate to remote services without plaintext credentials.

metadata.name: ATT&CK
metadata.value: T1550.002 Use Alternate Authentication Material: Pass the Hash

techniques.comment: Simulated exfiltration of staged sensitive files (credentials.txt, network-topology.txt) back to REMnux C2 server via existing HTTPS beacon channel.

metadata.name: Method
metadata.value: Sliver download command over HTTPS C2 channel
